subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale guard assertions are fixed, should the verified grouped action revisions be approved for the security-, token-, release-, and agent-bearing workflows?
rationale: The revisions resolve to official tags and no concrete supply-chain regression was found, but the protected security label and the breadth of code-executing workflow surfaces require a human owner to accept the remaining third-party execution boundary.

options.title: Approve after synchronized repair
options.body: Fix the four assertions, rerun exact-head workflow validation, and approve the verified immutable revisions as one grouped update.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Separate token, release, security, and Codex action revisions into smaller PRs for independent approval and validation.

options.title: Defer the grouped update
options.body: Keep the current revisions until security owners are ready to review and validate the full grouped change.

recommendation.title: Approve after synchronized repair
recommendation.body: Fix the four assertions, rerun exact-head workflow validation, and approve the verified immutable revisions as one grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest central workflow history and general GitHub-area ownership signal among the identified people, though the security team remains the policy owner for the protected paths.
